articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Nov. 3, 2026 result: Okey Anyiam won the race for Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 3 with 4,839,230 votes (50.0%); opponents: Thomas Smith (R) 4,601,878 (47.6%), Mark Ash (LIB) 231,048 (2.4%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
